name: DES Y1

bins._note_lam_top_edge: 200 stands in for infinity. cluster-lensing-cov/configs/des_y1.json uses 1000 instead; 200 is kept because the counts and the selection function were computed against it, and it is the upper limit of a lambda integral, so the choice is not free.
bins._note_sigma_z: sigma_z is the photo-z scatter, 0.01. The 0.03 seen in the y3 configs is 3*sigma_z, the window half-width used by the parabolic b_sel projection weight (clenspy.kernels.photoz_projection, n_sigma=3) -- it is NOT the scatter. The counts kernel S_j uses sigma_z itself. Confusing them widens one kernel 3x or narrows the other 3x, in opposite directions and silently.

sources._provenance: cluster-lensing-cov/configs/des_y1.json -- 'DES Y1 source-distribution fit used by upstream validation commit b7fd6e4'
sources._units: sigma_gamma dimensionless; n_src_arcmin in arcmin^-2; z_star/m/beta are the Rozo et al. 2011 eq. 14 shape parameters

_note_z_integration_range: ZT_LO/ZT_HI of make_hod_norm_impact.py -- the true-redshift quadrature range, wider than the bin edges because the photo-z kernel scatters across them.
_note_omega_z: omega_z names a transcribed polynomial fit in clenspy.survey, not a number in this file: a fit is code, its choice is configuration. The DES Y1 fit is valid on z in [0.20, 0.65].
